why: Last decision. Forward view shows a new area (bench, stool, brick wall, a post at the very left edge) with no second full gate visible - can't independently confirm a distinct center-gate pass from this frame alone, though pose has advanced steadily forward through the room since k6/k7. Downward camera again shows the wire-cage/stuffed-animal structure, now closer, at the bottom-right. Proposed move descends (dz-0.18, appropriate for settling over a table-height target) and heads to (1.62,-0.60,1.23), close to (1.57,-0.44) where we had our clearest look at the cage+animal at k5, with high trust (1.24). No specific problem to point to, and it moves toward the last confirmed animal sighting while descending to hover height, so approving as the flight's final move.
